notes: Four answers were close calls, so flag them if the results look off. (1) Q-T1-PICKUP, Q-T1-WEIGHT and Q-T1-SELLER-LIMIT: their subjects contain dimension words ('cut-off', 'limit'). I answered YES because each question's full sealed inventory is entirely about that cut-off or limit, so every proposition is about the named concern. A stricter reading, that any subject naming a limit or cut-off names only a dimension, would make all three NO. (2) Q-T1-DAMAGE: CLAIM-a5ea91e9e3d8cae0 says '48 hours' without 'of delivery'; I treated the starting point as implied. Nothing was answered NO as undecidable. The 35 packets reduce to 8 distinct ones; files with the same ledger and timepoint have byte-identical packets. Each answer was checked only against its own file's packet, and I read no other repository files.
